about_the_game:
All characters in this game are adults.

"On the forbidden island, unveil the deepest layers of human nature—"

You, an adventurer chasing legends, set foot on the isolated "Unexplored Realm."
This is not only an island of unknown creatures but also home to three young women who defy societal constraints:
the pure and innocent younger sister, the rebellious punk girl, and the rational, restrained mature beauty.
Beneath their elegant facades lurk twisted desires even they themselves are unaware of.

Your mission: With "love" as your blade, and "domination" as your chain.

Erode their defenses with tenderness, shatter their disguises with force.

In the game of ambiguity and confrontation, guide them to confront the "true cravings" deep within their souls.

Elevate "taming" to an art form: from resistance to surrender, from independence to dependence—
Witness their gradual awakening into "Eternal Pledgers" willing to offer everything.

Three fallen muses await your inscription.

Innocent Younger Sister: A flower of immorality craving complete exposure beneath a pure smile.

Punk Rebel: Masochistic fantasies wrapped in sharp edges, using degradation to affirm her existence.

Mature Beauty: Sensory cravings behind a mask of rationality, awaiting the ecstasy of conquest at the edge of knowledge.

Immersive "Psyche Conditioning" System

Deep Branching Narrative: Each choice triggers chain reactions, leading to vastly different paths of submission.

Desire Meter Manifestation: Dynamically capture the progression of psychological breakdown through micro-expressions and body language.

Scene Narrative Aesthetics: Japanese anime-style visuals interwoven with light and shadow, interpreting erotic tension through visual art.

 

"This is not mere conquest—it is a ritual of soul remolding."

This is an R18+ Adult Visual Novel RPG, featuring deep content such as [Psychological Domination], [Harem Dynamics], [Divergent Ending Choices].
Embark on this dangerous and opulent soul hunt—
Will you bestow upon them the meaning of "corruption," or be consumed by desire?

>>> Add to Wishlist & unlock limited-time Pure Love vs. Corruption exploration event! <<<
